You want input$CPR1, that's how you access any inputs in Shiny. 




On Sun, Apr 26, 2015 at 7:05 AM -0700, "Glenn Schultz" <glennm...@gmail.com> wrote:

Reading through other posts I have the reactive output down the command should read 
output$text1 <- renderText({PassThrough.1()@WAL}).

However, the value of CPR1 is not passing into the function.
